title: configfile module settings
description: The settings.json file of a configfile module: the files of the module, how each one is deployed, and the scripts run when the module is deployed or undeployed. See https://docs.configfile.sh/reference/modules/

$schema.description: The JSON Schema of this file, for editor completion and validation. configfile ignores it.

pre_deploy.description: The name of a script of the repository (as listed by configfile scripts list), run by configfile modules deploy before the files of the module are deployed. When it fails, the module is not deployed.

post_deploy.description: The name of a script of the repository (as listed by configfile scripts list), run by configfile modules deploy once the files of the module are deployed.

pre_undeploy.description: The name of a script of the repository, run by configfile modules undeploy before the files of the module are removed. When it fails, the module stays deployed.

post_undeploy.description: The name of a script of the repository, run by configfile modules undeploy once the files of the module are removed.

oneOf.description: Deprecated: the configfile 0.3 format, a plain list of entries. Put the list in a "files" key instead. It will stop working in 2.0.

source_path.description: Path of the file or folder, relative to the module folder. It must stay inside the module folder.

target_path.description: Where the file is deployed. ~ is your home folder. A relative path is relative to the home folder for global files, and to the current folder for local files.

deploy.description: Where the file is deployed: "global" into your home folder (configfile modules deploy), "local" into the current folder (configfile modules deploy --local), "none" keeps it in the repository without deploying it.

method.description: How a global file is deployed: "copy" (the default) copies it, and configfile updates the copy when the repository changes, keeping changes made on this machine; "link" makes a symbolic link to configfile's copy of the repository. Local files are always copied.

global.description: Deprecated: the older spelling of "deploy" (true is "global", false is "local"). It will stop working in 2.0.

allOf.description: Every entry names its file, except those that are never deployed.
